proposed_comments.body:
### Declare the bitmap release API (3/3)

**Severity:** `high`

The existing `DestroyIcon` declaration releases HICON resources, not the HBITMAP copies returned by `GetIconInfo`. Add the GDI `DeleteObject` signature with a Win32 BOOL return value so the companion `finally` can release those bitmap copies. Keep the current extracted-icon destruction as well; these are separate ownership obligations. Apply all three suggestions together.

```suggestion
        [DllImport("gdi32.dll")]
        [return: MarshalAs(UnmanagedType.Bool)]
        private static extern bool DeleteObject(IntPtr bitmap);

        [DllImport("gdi32.dll")]
```
